Thank you for joining the "○○ Aviation Science Museum" interactive experience.
Please read the following notice before starting:

1. Copyright
   The game program and art assets (including 2D/3D aircraft models, character costumes, scenes, UI, music, and sound effects) are jointly owned by "○○ Aviation Science Museum" and the development team "Lotify", and are protected by copyright law.
   Please do not record or re-shoot outside the museum for commercial promotion, secondary distribution, or upload to any platform.

2. Player-Created Content
   Content created during the experience (such as avatar photos, doodle aircraft, short videos) is for this experience and in-museum display only.
   If you choose "Share" on the ending screen, you agree to let the museum / Lotify upload it to designated platforms on your behalf.

3. Portraits and Personal Data
   The museum does not retain raw facial-recognition images; only extracted features are converted into paper-doll data.
   Related data will be deleted or de-identified after you leave the museum, in accordance with the museum's privacy policy.

4. Other
   This experience is for exhibition use only and is not a commercial game for sale.
   For cooperation, licensing, or technical issues, please contact the "○○ Aviation Science Museum" service desk.
